The '''''Outcast'''''<ref name="Declassified">{{SW|url=news/bad-batch-declassified-bad-territory|text=''Bad Batch'' Declassified: 5 Highlights from "Bad Territory"}}</ref> was a [[starship]] owned by the [[bounty hunter]] [[Fennec Shand]] at the beginning of the [[Imperial Era]].<ref name="Cornered" /> As her personal vessel, Shand had the ''Outcast'' outfitted with her unique modifications. It was able to store all of her essential gear as well as having a hold for any successful scores.<ref name="Databank" />

Shand traveled to [[Pantora]] in the ship after being tipped off by a [[Raspar Six|contact]] that [[Omega]], a child whom she had been hired to retrieve, was on the [[moon]].<ref name="Cornered" /> She later made a deal with [[Hunter]] and [[Wrecker]] of [[Clone Force 99]] and was accompanied by the rogue [[Cloning|clones]] onboard the ''Outcast'' to the [[planet]] [[Veelo]] for a [[Hunt for Sylar Saris|job]] hunting down [[Sylar Saris]].<ref name="BT">{{TBB|Bad Territory}}</ref>
